hints.title: Prefix Sum Grid Arrays
hints.text: Precompute row and column prefix sums to compute any horizontal or vertical line sum in constant time.

hints.title: Largest Side Length First
hints.text: Iterate side length k downwards from min(m, n) down to 2, returning the first valid size found.

hints.title: Verify Rows Columns and Diagonals
hints.text: For a top-left corner (r, c), check if all k rows, k columns, and both diagonals match the target sum.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing row and column sums cell by cell takes O(m * n * k^3) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Row and column prefix sums allow checking all k rows and k columns in O(k) time per candidate square.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks both diagonals and all rows/columns against the first row target sum.
